traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The caryatid column is immune to any spell or effect
that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The caryatid column has advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The caryatid column’s weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Shatter Weapons
traits.text:
Whenever a character strikes a caryatid column with
a non-adamantine, nonmagical weapon, the character must succeed on a
DC 14 Strength saving throw or the weapon shatters into pieces.
